note: Boysen SP on Boysen Reservoir, at the mouth of Wind River Canyon. Tamarask Campground is on the east shore south of the marina, its sites on open sand and gravel terraces around two small coves; the reservoir draws down hard by late summer. Harmful cyanobacteria toxin advisories named Tamarask in summer 2026. The park has many other campgrounds (Brannon, Tough Creek, Lower and Upper Wind River, Lakeside and more). --Claude
